file_stem: RWB E1 066 Interaction ledger store and writer
title: Interaction ledger store and writer
goal: One append-only, gap-free ledger per case, written inside the transaction of each contact
why: 'What happened on this case?' must be complete and tamper-proof. The ledger records what happened; the decision log records why. The two are linked.
triggers: Case owner records a call or visit
ace_note: No ACE read. EFS contact history stays in ACE (v_ace_efs_action) and is merged on screen by E1-023, not copied here.

writes.note: append only; case_seq, event_code, actor, source_ref, decision_log_id

stores: Trigger tr_interaction_append_only; pg_advisory_xact_lock per case; incident LEDGER_WRITE_FAILED
rules: BR4: append-only; a correction is a new entry
BR5: a failed write stops the action and raises an incident
BR6: the ledger records what happened, the decision log why; they are linked
example: u-owner-02 logs CALL OUTBOUND 2026-12-02 10:15, RIGHT_PARTY, promise 25,000.00 for 2026-12-15
